newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Luxembourg yr/yr inflation 1.35 pct in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Luxembourg yr/yr inflation 1.35 pct in Jan.

text.p: The Luxembourg Statistics Office released the following data on inflation on Thursday.
LUXEMBOURG CONSUMER PRICES * Feb Jan Jan 1996
NOTE - * index as measured on the first of the month; (!) provisional, to be confirmed on April 3.
NOTE - base re-set at 1996 following update to underlying basket of goods and services.
Statec said month-on-month price rises were mainly seen for housing, water, electricity, fuels, for health care and for entertainment and culture. For communications lower prices were recorded.
